title: Owner: phone Meadow speed on the Note 10+ is acceptable for now, pending an S24 Ultra test
context: On the Note 10+ the phone Meadow page runs at 42 fps inside the shell and 35 fps with the time pop-over. Full screen holds 60.
options: Step the glass down per device
outcome: The owner said: "The performance of the Meadow is acceptable for now on Note 10+. We may do a separate performance pass in the future. For now, this performance is acceptable pending a test on a S24 Ultra Flagship." No change for now. The S24 Ultra test should run the same mbench.apk and sbench.apk kept in device-pass/apps, built at 9e41b3ba.
